verdict.rationale: Notte's docs state that its remote browser infrastructure includes captcha solving, and the founder says it handles about 60% of providers (including reCAPTCHA and Cloudflare) with others still in progress. That is a stated stance of automatic solving with partial coverage, but it rests on a one-line docs mention and a community comment. Missing for 10: a dedicated captcha documentation page, a list of supported and unsupported captcha providers, documented behavior or error signaling when a captcha cannot be solved (to avoid silent failures), a documented human-in-the-loop fallback, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can rely on a documented captcha stance — automatic solving, human fallback, or explicit non-support — instead of silent task failures

citations.quote: Fast, scalable browsers with anti-detection, proxies, and captcha solving.
we can solve ~60% of providers right now (incl reCAPTCHA, Cloudflare, and main ones) and some others are still work in progress
